title: ai/watch
blurb: A daily AI briefing written, fact-checked and published by a pipeline of agents with no human review. Every sentence is tied to a quote found word for word in its source; code — not the model — gates what gets published, and every refusal is shown with its reason.

title: Komeet (Tila)
blurb: Contributed to a startup's mobile product and its API — feature development across a React Native app and its backend service.

title: funk-it-up
blurb: A 3D rhythm game — jump in time with whatever track you're playing, scoring on how tightly you land on the beat. Built on React Three Fiber with Rapier physics.

title: NeJa
blurb: A component / design-system library built on Sanzo Wada's A Dictionary of Color Combinations — a presentation site pairing his historic palettes with variant-driven UI components. Shipped in an afternoon.

title: Augmented Engineering — TS Backend
blurb: A TypeScript backend starter exploring augmented-engineering workflows and modern Node service architecture.

title: DevRel.io Apps
blurb: Internal developer-relations application suite built during an eXalt-IT engineering program (300+ commits). Rebuilt here as a case study since the source lives in a private GitLab org.

title: Rendering Event (TDD Kata)
blurb: A test-driven-development kata modelling an event-rendering domain — practicing clean design and red/green/refactor discipline.

title: Stach
blurb: Hairdresser reservation platform — React Native mobile app with an Express/Node backend and a web front end. Book appointments, browse salons, manage availability.

title: Locapic
blurb: Real-time chat and geolocation app built with React Native and Socket.IO — share your live location and message nearby users.

title: mymoviz
blurb: A movies and series browser, rebuilt in 2026 from my 2021 bootcamp project. Trending rows, genre browsing and search kept in the URL, served by a Cloudflare Worker that keeps the TMDB key server-side and caches at the edge. Episode tracking for the series you follow is next.

title: Planity
blurb: Four-year mission on France's leading beauty-booking platform. Owned Tap to Pay contactless payments end to end on iOS & Android (200+ PRs across 3 repos), built the passwordless Magic Link sign-in, and contributed to the planity.com rebuild and a shared mobile / tablet / web monorepo.

title: Mon Spécialiste Auto
blurb: Auto-inspection startup, web and mobile. New Node/Express API routes with role-based access, license-plate blurring through an AWS Lambda, live Google Maps mission tracking, and Cypress / testRigor end-to-end coverage.
